method.loss: max(0, -Variance) per counted SKU per period — LOSSES ONLY; positive variances never offset a loss (the net variance hides it)
method.rate: median across periods of loss_units / period_weeks
method.fraction: median across periods of loss_units / modelled consumption
method.shrink: James-Stein toward the reporting-group median, weight n/(n+2.0)
method.cap: uplift capped at 50% of modelled demand; capped SKUs are flagged investigate, not silently inflated
method.absent: a SKU missing from a count file was NOT counted — skipped, never zero
